title.narrative: Strengthening Civil Society for Greater Advocacy and Impact on Human Rights and Democracy Issues in Jamaica

description.narrative: Whilst NIA's core mandate is that of building integrity and fighting corruption, it recognizes that success cannot be achieved if other civil society organizations ¿ regardless of their focus/priority area - are not well equipped to advocate on issues of national relevance. It will take ¿all hands-on deck¿ for Jamaica to meet its targets, with a civil society that is able to ensure compliance with the various international treaties that the country has obligated itself to. In this regard, it is imperative to note that for any significant advances to be made we will have to abide by and strive for obtaining SDGs 16 (Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions) and 17(Partnership).
